description: This file implements the SocketPort class, including socket creation, configuration, connection management, data transmission, and multicast group handling, with platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems.

classes.name: WinSocketInitializer
classes.description: Initializes Windows Sockets API and retrieves function pointers for advanced socket operations.

methods.name: ReceiveFrom
methods.description: Receives data from a socket, extracting interface index information for IPv4 and IPv6 packets.

methods.name: ConstructSocket
methods.description: Creates and configures a socket based on NodeId and interface parameters, handling platform-specific socket options and binding.

methods.name: SetNonBlocking
methods.description: Sets a socket to non-blocking mode, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: DestroySocket
methods.description: Closes and invalidates a socket handle.

methods.name: BufferAlignment
methods.description: Configures socket buffer sizes and allocates internal buffers for sending and receiving data.

methods.name: WaitForOpen
methods.description: Waits until the socket connection is established or timeout occurs.

methods.name: WaitForWriteComplete
methods.description: Waits until all pending data is sent or timeout occurs.

methods.name: WaitForClosure
methods.description: Waits until the socket is closed or timeout occurs.

methods.name: Events
methods.description: Determines socket events to monitor based on current state and error conditions.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles socket events, triggering read, write, accept, or close operations based on event flags.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket into internal buffer, handling errors and partial reads.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Sends data from internal buffer over the socket, handling partial sends and errors.

methods.name: Closed
methods.description: Closes the socket and cleans up resources.

methods.name: Opened
methods.description: Marks the socket as open and ready for communication.

methods.name: Accepted
methods.description: Handles acceptance of incoming connection.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection and returns the new socket handle.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection and updates internal socket handle.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Sets up the socket to listen for incoming connections.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Joins a multicast group on the socket.

methods.name: Leave
methods.description: Leaves a multicast group on the socket.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Joins a multicast source group on the socket.

methods.name: Leave
methods.description: Leaves a multicast source group on the socket.
